observable_test: Attempts the movement. Shape is inconsistent, often needs the demonstration repeated. Engaged and safe.
Produces the movement correctly when cued and unhurried. Falls apart when pace or a partner is added.
Holds the movement under a simple external demand — a moving partner, a called cue, mild fatigue.
Adjusts the movement to what the opponent gives. Chooses between options rather than running one pattern.
Keeps shape, tempo and decision quality when pressured, tired, or after being caught. Resets without being told.
Can demonstrate correctly at low speed and correct a peer's error without coaching it wrongly.
